facebook.caption:
19,455 reviews. 4.5 stars. And most tourists still don't plan enough time here.

Sunworld Hòn Thơm is three things in one: a record-breaking cable car ride over open ocean, an Ancient Rome-themed shopping hub, and a full island water park on the other side.

The cable car alone spans 7,899m. One of the longest non-stop cable car rides in the world. You feel it.

Book a full day. Not a half day. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
